# Askovo website entry

Askovo is now presented inside the unified OVO website, not as a separately styled homepage.

- Unified product home: https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/
- English home: https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/en.html
- Real cases: https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/cases.html
- Engineering journal: https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/journal.html
- Askovo technical blog: https://roy-tong.github.io/Askovo/blog/index.html
- Get started: https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/start.html
- Askovo repository and full agent entry: https://github.com/roy-tong/Askovo (repo-root llms.txt)
- Current capabilities: https://github.com/roy-tong/Askovo/blob/main/docs/feature-status.md

Deep product guides and examples remain at their existing Askovo URLs, including /examples/decision-replay.html, /guides/need-validation.html, /first-look.html, /claims.html and /faq.html.
